desc:
STAND FIGHTING GAME
Inspired by JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

-- BASIC CONTROLS --
Q - Summon Stand
LMB - Stand Punches
RMB (In Shift-Lock) - Stand Strike
F - Block
Ctrl - Toggle Sprint
Left Alt - Dash
M - Menu
N - Emotes
